scope: City and urban settlement candidates from existing PLACES definitions, including named urban sites drawn with castle symbols. Not a complete historical gazetteer.
meaning_of_needs_placement: Existing marker is already defined in map source; needs_sprite means missing painted artwork, not a missing source marker.
coordinate_policy: Coordinates copied from original manifest for audit only; do not treat as newly verified. Operational recovered-sprite coordinates remain authoritative in data/sprites/catalog.json.
